prompt: Was the founder of the bank that was established 42 years before the National Banking Act was expanded to include the Territory of Hawai'i still alive when it acquired Pioneer Federal Savings Bank?
answer: No. The bank was founded in 1858 as Bishop & Co. by **Charles Reed Bishop**, 42 years before the National Banking Act was extended to Hawaiʻi in 1900. Bishop died in **1915**, long before First Hawaiian acquired Pioneer Federal Savings Bank in **1993** (completed August 6).
